bio: I am an aspiring cybersecurity professional currently pursuing my B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering. Equipped with industry certifications from Google and Palo Alto Networks, I specialize in vulnerability management, network security, and ethical hacking. I have practical experience developing custom security tools—such as honeypots and packet sniffers—and conducting Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT). I am dedicated to safeguarding organizational data and continuously growing my expertise in threat mitigation.
